name: 46425-longthink-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1). Driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine driven by guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, 128 requests, warmup 64 and cooldown 16 requests (both `mode: requests`), 3600 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 512 prompt tokens and 8000 output tokens per request (fixed, not sampled), greedy (`temperature 0.0`), 128 requests, each carrying `thinking_token_budget: 10000`.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter reasoning assistant writing very long answers to short prompts for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Interpreter, hardware and environment live in env.yaml.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Must stay one-line JSON: the engine-side reader is flat and silently drops indented keys.
# `<|vision_pad|>` as the end delimiter is DELIBERATE, not a typo: it is a single token in this
# checkpoint's vocabulary that a text-only sampler cannot emit, so the thinking block stays open
# for the whole generation. With the checkpoint's own `</think>` the block length becomes an
# accident of the sampled text.
reasoning-config: {"reasoning_start_str": "<think>", "reasoning_end_str": "<|vision_pad|>"}

max-model-len: 8704
max-num-seqs: 64
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false

error.text: both versions ship a syntax error in vLLM's engine core (a merge artefact fixed upstream later)
